summary.what_it_does: Smartbird describes itself as a provider of dedicated AI infrastructure delivered as a managed service. The company says it builds, deploys, and operates the infrastructure on behalf of customers. The pitch is that customers get the performance, control, and scalability of owning hardware without the capital expense or day-to-day operational work. The page does not list specific hardware, pricing, locations, or service tiers.
notable: Managed dedicated AI infrastructure instead of customer-owned hardware
Company says it handles build, deployment, and operations
Page includes a letter from the CEO, Nadia Carlsten
caveats: The page gives no pricing, specs, or availability details
Target customers and regions are not specified
Listed in a copywriting directory, which does not match its infrastructure focus
